summary: Comprehensive testing of BTP Manager structured roles feature completed successfully. Backend APIs for creating/updating outils with structured roles [{name, permissions, description}] work correctly. Frontend displays role names on cards, shows permissions in view modal, and loads roles correctly in edit form. All 13 backend tests passed, all frontend UI tests passed.

issues: Console warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' - minor React hydration warning in role template dropdown, does not affect functionality

backend: Login with Direction account (superdadmin@gmail.com / Superadmin123!) successful
GET /api/domaines returns domaines with outils and roles_disponibles
GET /api/outils returns outils with structured roles
POST /api/outils with structured roles [{name, permissions, description}] creates outil correctly
Existing outils have structured roles format
POST /api/outils/{id}/assign with invalid role returns 400 error
GET /api/outils/{id}/users returns assigned users with outil_role
frontend: Outil cards display role names (viewer, conduc, chef_equipe)
Shield icon opens roles modal showing permissions
Roles modal displays role name, description, and permission badges
Create outil modal shows structured role form
Adding custom role via Enter key works
Permission toggle buttons work in create form
Outil creation with structured roles succeeds
Edit modal loads existing roles correctly
Expanded domaine shows outil roles correctly

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Console warning about <span> inside <option> in role template dropdown - cosmetic issue only
seed_data_creation: Test outil 'TEST_Structured_Roles' was created and deleted during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Structured roles feature is fully working. Backend stores roles as JSON array of {name, permissions, description} objects. Frontend Outils.js has getRoleNames() helper to extract role names from both structured and legacy formats. The existing 'Checklist Sécurité' outil has 3 structured roles: viewer, conduc, chef_equipe with their respective permissions.

structured_roles_backend.create_outil: POST /api/outils accepts roles_disponibles as List[{name, permissions, description}]
structured_roles_backend.role_validation: POST /api/outils/{id}/assign validates role against structured role names
structured_roles_backend.backward_compatibility: Legacy string roles are handled via getRoleNames() helper

structured_roles_frontend.card_display: Role names shown as badges on outil cards
structured_roles_frontend.view_modal: Shield icon opens modal showing role name, description, and permission badges
structured_roles_frontend.create_form: Structured role form with permission toggles and role templates
structured_roles_frontend.edit_form: Existing roles loaded correctly with permissions
